name: Tod's Omotesando Building
note: Harajuku (9235302289).jpg (2736x3648) is a clear upward view of the branching concrete facade (checked visually). Omotesando buildings.jpg (4608x3456) shows Tod's on the right beside the Keyaki Building. Other files in the category are under 1200px.

name: Tossols-Basil Athletics Track
note: Seven CC0 photos (2048x1536) from 2012: 003/004 show the running track ('Laufbahn'), 001/002 the Corten entrance, 005/006 floodlight masts, 007 the attached football field. Judged from descriptions and category, not viewed.

name: Umbrella House (Kasa no Ie)
note: Eleven CC0 photos from June 2022 (4032x3024) of the house as re-erected on the Vitra Campus, plus two CC BY-SA 4.0 photos from 2025. Some of the 2022 series may be interiors; pick exterior frames when choosing.

name: Villa Verde Housing
view: street elevation of three row houses as handed over: each steep gable has its built two-storey half (with door and windows) and an empty half under the same roof
note: No Commons category or files found. Sources confirm two-storey row houses, half built and half left for residents to fill (57 m2 growing to about 85 m2), under a pitched roof. Window positions are schematic; the number of houses shown (three) is illustrative of the row.

name: Disney Ice (Anaheim Ice)
note: Only one file: Anaheimice.jpg, 2272x1704, described as 'Exterior view of Anaheim Ice (formerly Disney Ice)'. Its licence is the Commons 'Attribution' template (free use with credit, equivalent in effect to CC BY), not a numbered CC licence; the owner may want to confirm that is acceptable.

name: The Index
note: The Index Tower - panoramio.jpg (2448x3264, Aidas U.) is a full-height street view of the tower with Emirates Towers behind (checked visually). It is not yet in Category:The Index (Dubai), which holds only two other, weaker files.
